tagline.en: ByteDance's Depth Anything 3 — a strong foundation model for depth and geometry from images.
tagline.zh: 字节跳动的 Depth Anything 3——从图像预测深度与几何的强大基础模型。

en: Depth Anything 3, from ByteDance Seed, is the latest in the widely-used Depth Anything line of monocular depth and geometry foundation models. It estimates depth and geometric structure from ordinary images, extending the series toward richer 3D understanding.

As a foundation model it is designed to generalize across diverse scenes without per-scene tuning, which is why the Depth Anything family is a common building block for downstream 3D and reconstruction work. WorldFoundry surfaces a Depth Anything 3 export route for producing geometry outputs.

In WorldFoundry, the in-tree route is registered separately from the geometry-prior profile, so you can use Depth Anything 3 either as a direct depth/geometry step or as a prior that feeds downstream 3D and 4D stages.
zh: Depth Anything 3 出自字节跳动 Seed 团队，是被广泛使用的 Depth Anything 单目深度与几何基础模型系列的最新一代。它从普通图像估计深度与几何结构，把该系列推向更丰富的 3D 理解。
作为基础模型，它被设计为无需逐场景调参即可在多样场景上泛化，这也是 Depth Anything 家族常被用作下游 3D 与重建工作构件的原因。WorldFoundry 提供了一条 Depth Anything 3 导出路径，用于产出几何输出。
在 WorldFoundry 中，该内置路径与 geometry-prior 配置分开注册，因此你既可以把 Depth Anything 3 用作直接的深度/几何步骤，也可以把它当作先验，供下游 3D、4D 环节使用。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you need robust depth or geometry estimation from images that generalizes across scenes — either as a standalone step or as a prior for 3D and 4D pipelines.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从图像做稳健、可跨场景泛化的深度或几何估计时使用它——既可作为独立步骤，也可作为 3D、4D pipeline 的先验。

notFor.en: Not a generative video or world model — it estimates geometry from real images rather than imagining new scenes.
notFor.zh: 它不是生成式视频或世界模型——它从真实图像估计几何，而非想象新场景。

en: Latest in the Depth Anything depth/geometry foundation-model line
Estimates depth and geometry from ordinary images
Generalizes across diverse scenes without per-scene tuning
Available as a direct export route or as a geometry prior
zh: Depth Anything 深度/几何基础模型系列的最新一代
从普通图像估计深度与几何
无需逐场景调参即可跨多样场景泛化
可作为直接导出路径或几何先验使用
